pages.text: The $(l)Mind Stone$() stores experience. Craft it from books, Red Matter and lapis. It fits the necklace curio slot.$(br2)Toggle it with $(l)G$().$(br2)$(l)Hidden abilities$()$(br)$(li)While active it drains up to 50 XP from you into the stone every tick, with no cap on how much it can hold.$(li)$(l)Right-click$() while it is switched off releases 50 XP back to you.$(li)Its stored amount is shown in its tooltip.$(li)On a pedestal it pulls in nearby experience orbs and absorbs them.$(li)Although it fits the necklace slot, it does not tick there; keep it in your hotbar or off-hand to drain XP.
